statements.status_notes: Not affected. GHSA-mhm7-754m-9p8w (jackson-databind @JsonView creator-property bypass, no CVE assigned, Moderate) allows attacker-controlled JSON to populate a constructor parameter restricted with @JsonView when that parameter is also bound via @JsonTypeInfo(include = As.EXTERNAL_PROPERTY). Exploitation requires all three annotations combined in application code: a property-based @JsonCreator, a @JsonView-restricted creator parameter, and an EXTERNAL_PROPERTY type binding on that parameter. Verified across the full PingAccess 9.1 distribution (all 165 runtime jars and 83 upgrade-utility jars, class-by-class): zero PingAccess classes reference @JsonView or As.EXTERNAL_PROPERTY; the 30 classes using @JsonCreator never combine it with views or external type ids; the only @JsonTypeInfo usage is include = As.PROPERTY in pf-admin-api-clients-v2 model classes with no view restrictions. PingAccess also does not deserialize client request bodies into typed bean graphs (no spring-web/spring-webmvc in the distribution; JSON parsing is limited to trusted sources - token providers, JWE-protected structures, cluster-internal channels). The OpenTelemetry agent jar bundles its own shaded, classloader-isolated jackson 2.22.2 for internal telemetry export, which is above the affected line and does not process product data. All code-level preconditions are absent, so the vulnerable deserialization path cannot be constructed regardless of library version. Remediation rides the standard Jackson library update cadence (fixed in 2.21.5).
